title: Anthropic product team sees personnel change, Claude Code lead departs
excerpt: It is reported that Cat Wu, the product lead for Anthropic's Claude Code, has left the company. She recently posted on X that Friday was her last day at Anthrop
content_html:
It is reported that Cat Wu, the product lead for Anthropic's Claude Code, has left the company. She recently posted on X that Friday was her last day at Anthropic, but did not disclose the reason for her departure or where she will go next.

Cat Wu was previously responsible for two products, Claude Code and Cowork. Before joining Anthropic, she worked as an engineer at Scale AI and Dagster, and later moved into venture capital at Index Ventures.

According to reports, she joined Anthropic in August 2024, initially serving as a product manager for research, and later took part in product management for Claude Code and Cowork. Her departure means a change in leadership for two of Anthropic's important AI products.
